logger.doc:name: Log Contact Detail Enrichment Start
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_DETAIL_ENRICHMENT_STARTED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", changeType: vars.changeType default "UNKNOWN" }, "application/json")]

salesforce:query.doc:name: Retrieve Salesforce Contact Details
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, AccountId, Title, Department, ReportsToId, LastModifiedDate FROM Contact WHERE Id = ':contactId'

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var contactRecords = (payload default []) as Array --- contactRecords[0] default {}
%dw 2.0 output application/java var contactRecords = (payload default []) as Array --- contactRecords[0].AccountId default null
%dw 2.0 output application/java var contactRecords = (payload default []) as Array --- contactRecords[0].ReportsToId default null

logger.doc:name: Log Contact Detail Enrichment Result
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_DETAIL_ENRICHMENT_COMPLETED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactDetails.Id default vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", accountId: vars.accountId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", reportsToId: vars.reportsToId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactFound: !isEmpty(vars.contactDetails) }, "application/json")]

salesforce:query.doc:name: Retrieve Related Account Details
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Name, Industry, Type, AnnualRevenue FROM Account WHERE Id = ':accountId'

set-variable.doc:name: Store Related Account Details
Assign Default Account Information

logger.doc:name: Log Account Enrichment Result
logger.message: #[write({ event: "ACCOUNT_ENRICHMENT_COMPLETED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", accountId: vars.accountId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", accountName: vars.accountDetails.Name default "Unknown", accountAvailable: (vars.accountDetails.Name default "Unknown") != "Unknown" }, "application/json")]

until-successful.doc:name: Retry Retrieve Reports To Contact Details

salesforce:query.doc:name: Retrieve Reports To Contact Details
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE Id = ':reportsToId'

set-variable.doc:name: Store Reports To Contact Details

logger.doc:name: Log Reports To Contact Enrichment Result
logger.message: #[write({ event: "REPORTS_TO_ENRICHMENT_COMPLETED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", reportsToId: vars.reportsToId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", managerName: vars.managerDetails.Name default "Unassigned", managerAvailable: (vars.managerDetails.Name default "Unassigned") != "Unassigned" }, "application/json")]
